headline: Meta just created a moderation nightmare for its smart glasses
summary: Meta's smart glasses are facing intense public backlash. Concerns are growing over privacy erosion and increased surveillance. Some users are exploiting the glasses to film unsuspecting people for 'pranks.'

headline: Qualcomm is about to raise prices and that’s bad news for everyone
summary: Qualcomm notified customers of upcoming double-digit price increases. The new prices will apply to products shipped after September 1st. The company cites higher supplier costs and ongoing component shortages.

headline: Midjourney bought the astrology app Co-Star
summary: AI image generation startup Midjourney has acquired the astrology app Co-Star. This move marks Midjourney's expansion into a new content area. Co-Star offers personalized daily horoscopes and astrological insights.

headline: DJI camera clone company Xtra is halting and refunding all preorders
summary: Xtra Technology, known for cloning DJI cameras, has abruptly halted all preorders. The company removed its new Xtra Muse 2 Pro camera from its website. All customers who preordered will receive full refunds.

headline: In The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3, the Balrog Speaks — and It's Simon Pegg | Comic Con 2026
summary: The Balrog will speak for the first time in 'Rings of Power' Season 3. Simon Pegg is confirmed to voice the iconic creature. This revelation was a highlight at Comic Con 2026.

headline: Steam Machine Too Expensive? Get Your Deck a Dock
summary: Steam Machines are proving too costly for many gamers. A Steam Deck dock offers a perfect, more affordable alternative. It expands the functionality of your existing Steam Deck setup.

headline: Today's Top Deals: MTG x Marvel Commander Bundle, LEGO One Piece, and Gran Turismo 7
summary: Score major savings on the MTG x Marvel Commander Bundle. Deals also include LEGO One Piece and Gran Turismo 7. Find discounts on Switch 2 consoles and memory cards this weekend.

headline: Marvel Is Finally Publishing New Indiana Jones Comics | Comic Con 2026
summary: Marvel Comics is set to launch a new series of Indiana Jones comics. The first installment, 'Indiana Jones and the Sword of Pandemonium,' arrives in December. The news was revealed at Comic Con 2026.

headline: Man describes trying to save mother and daughter who drowned off Essex beach
summary: A man recounted his harrowing attempt to save a mother and daughter. The two drowned tragically off an Essex beach. He heard desperate screams during a family birthday trip.

headline: 'Extremely significant' bomb in car intercepted on way to NI, Irish police say
summary: Irish police intercepted an 'extremely significant' car bomb. The device was reportedly en route to Northern Ireland. A woman in her 20s has been charged in connection with the plot.

headline: Andy Burnham's first week pledges - how much do they add up to?
summary: BBC Verify has assessed Andy Burnham's first-week pledges. The analysis scrutinizes the total cost of his new spending commitments. It also examines how these plans are intended to be funded.

headline: Angela Rayner rules out rent controls in England
summary: Angela Rayner has explicitly ruled out implementing rent controls in England. The housing secretary believes the Renters Rights' Act is already effective. She states the act is having a significant impact on the market.
